fact: The African Union says the Republic of Congo has already taken steps to modernize its education information system, with a workshop in Brazzaville on 19-21 May 2026 on the state of its EMIS.
The World Bank TRESOR ISR (Seq 4) records the indicator 'Implementation of integrated EMIS' as No at 5 Dec 2025 (target Yes by Jul 2030) and describes the baseline as 'No integrated EMIS available'.
